references.label: Upper VUK
references.description: The upper vertical up-kicker starts qualified Lotsaballs.
references.context: Shoot the upper VUK to start Lotsaballs.

references.label: Freeway ramp
references.description: The left ramp scores Freeway awards and the Lotsaballs Jackpot.
references.context: Shoot the left ramp for the Jackpot.

references.label: Left orbit
references.description: The left orbit feeds the subway used for the Quadruple Jackpot pair.
references.context: Send two balls through the left orbit.

references.label: Three-target banks
references.description: Either three-target bank qualifies Lotsaballs at the upper VUK.

references.label: Jackpot-relight saucers
references.description: The left, center, and right saucers can relight the Lotsaballs Jackpot.
references.context: Shoot any saucer to relight the Jackpot.
